headline: Desired capacity cannot go below minimum size — this configuration will not scale down and you'll keep paying for 3 instances.

findings.evidence_ref: desired_capacity set to 1 while min_size remains 3 in the same resource
findings.explanation: AWS will keep the ASG at min_size (3 instances) regardless of the desired_capacity setting. Your stated goal of scaling down to save costs on overnight traffic will silently fail, and you will continue paying for 3 instances.
